messages:
mira: FYI Goldleaf wants to cut their monthly commit by 15% but still expects the same multi-region failover and a 20% safety pool. asking for our ops read on feasibility and cost impact.

sam: oof. do they mean burst capacity as part of the commit or separate burst credits?

jess: from the contract draft they want preserved headroom for Q4 spikes and region failover (eu-west -> us-west). says 'no visible degradation'.

kyle: region constraints matter — eu-west GPU inventory is tight for Q4. if we reserve less headroom there, failover to us-west will increase egress and inter-region cost.

mira: can we run quick what-if with current utilization and their proposed 15% lower commit + 20% safety pool? what's the hit to available queue depth?

capacity-bot: quick forecast ready — baseline commit: 18,000 GPU hours/month. projected usage distribution (historic): eu-west 60%, us-west 30%, ap-sg 10%.

capacity-bot: scenario A (15% lower commit, keep 20% safety pool): committed hours -> 15,300. safety pool -> 3,060. effective guaranteed -> 12,240.

sam: math looks right. so under steady-state their guaranteed throughput drops ~32% vs prior. bursts would rely on our burst pool or cross-region shift.

jess: that will raise latency for eu-west since KV cache locality will be worse on failover. also model variants may need re-quantize for different hardware in us-west. ops overhead.

kyle: network note: cross-region failover will add ~40-120ms tail latency depending on path and peering. if Goldleaf's SLO is 200ms P95 for chat, we may breach it on failover.

mira: actionables: 1) quantify cost delta for us if we keep their failover guarantee (egress + burst usage) 2) propose an alternate buffer policy (sliding safety pool + seasonal top-up) 3) recommend contractual language about region preference and ordered failover.

ops-sre: preliminary cost delta: if failover uses us-west 25% of their monthly hours, incremental egress+networking + burst infra is ~ $14k/mo. if it's 50% shift during Q4 spikes, that goes to ~$38k/mo.

jess: suggestion for buffer policy: instead of flat 20% safety pool, do dynamic seasonal multiplier: base_buffer = 1.08, q4_multiplier = 1.25, rolling_variance = max(1.0, utilization_pctiles[95]/utilization_mean). result = commit * base_buffer * seasonal_factor * rolling_variance.

mira: can you show a quick example calc in minutes?

jess: example: commit=18k -> base 1.08 => 19,440. q4_multiplier 1.25 => 24,300. if rolling_variance 1.05 => ~25,515 hours. So if they reduce commit to 15,300, to meet Q4 target we'd still need to provision ~21K hours => they'd be short.

kyle: TL;DR: their ask to drop commit by 15% without altering failover/seasonal guarantees is a mismatch. options: (A) accept lower commit and offer paid burst credits for Q4, (B) require higher committed hours during seasonal months, (C) accept lower SLA for failover latency.

mira: prepare recommended proposal for commercial: suggest a hybrid: allow 12% reduction in baseline commit if they prepay Q4 top-up credits that guarantee regional failover up to 30% additional hours during 2-month window. also add explicit network latency appendix.

sam: +1. include a runbook appendix: how we do graceful degradation (model fallbacks, kv-cache warmers, prioritized routing) and estimated warm-up time ~45s for cold KV per user shard.

ops-sre: also include a clause about cross-region egress caps and overage billing at 1.6x standard egress rate during unplanned failover. that helps nudge them to accept committed regional buffers.

mira: I'll draft the note to commercial. anyone want to add numbers or objections before I send?

kyle: pls add explicit perf caveat for function-calling workloads — they are more sensitive to added RTT.

jess: add a sample contract snippet for sliding buffer and seasonal top-up: 

```
Buffer policy: committed_hours * base_buffer (1.08) + seasonal_topup
Q4 Top-up: prepay X hours (billed at committed rate) to enable regional failover without burst egress surcharge
Burst credits: optional, billed at premium rate, consumed after top-up
```

mira: perfect. I'll share draft by EOD. :thumbsup:

capacity-bot: saved scenario and attached forecast snapshot to ticket #GL-7643.

mira: thanks — closing loop here, will ping when draft sent. :wave:
